verdict_reason: A verbatim copy of the v3 suite, including a history comment that was never true of this file.

todos.issue: PimsConsignmentMapperV4Test is PimsConsignmentMapperV3Test copied, with only the class name, the mapper types and the V3/V4 names in one comment changed. No test in it covers anything specific to v0.4.0, so every consignment-mapping fix and test now has two homes.
todos.fix: Must: consignment mapping that is the same in v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 is tested once, and per-version tests cover only what differs. One way: share the mapper logic between versions and keep one suite, or parameterise one suite over both mappers.

todos.issue: Lines 193-195 narrate history: '// Given — the only other fields that delegate to PimsTransportMapperV4 and PimsLineItemMapperV4. Previously exercised on the null path only, so a broken or dropped wire-through would not have failed any test.' The comment describes other classes, uses a count ('the only other'), and was not even true of this new file. Line 156 is a bare '// Given'.
todos.fix: Must: no history, no Given/When/Then comment and no comment about other classes in this test. One way: delete both comments. The title mapSpecifiedConsignment_shouldMapTransportMovementAndConsignmentItem_viaDelegateMappers already says what the test proves.
